target_statement: Decide or exactly reduce kernel null-charge (KNC) for semidefinite compact-support completed-zeta Weil forms, including the quantifier distinction between an arbitrarily thin sequence and a full right germ.
first_unproved_edge: Completed-zeta KNC at every semidefinite support contact
architecture: Weil/support filtration only; no QP/Turan or four-cycle inference
mask_or_node_class: Exact completed-zeta Weil distribution, with prime powers at their exact logarithmic shifts
source_data_retained: Combined pole, digamma/archimedean, and von-Mangoldt prime-shift source
coefficient_cone_and_sign: All real or complex form-domain vectors; no positive-cone restriction
normalization: Nested compact-support logarithmic form domains with the project zero-extension convention
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: Not a QP height-window statement; Q_L is assumed semidefinite at the contact
quantifier_order: For every semidefinite support L, for every n in ker Q_L, there exists/equivalently there is one common right germ on which Q(n,v)=0 for every newly available test v
resolution_required: Exact equality on one nonempty support germ; o(1) charge is insufficient

rate_and_exponent_ledger.note: Qualitative support propagation; no QP/Turan exponent is involved.

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: The certified positive base and compact-resolvent/continuous ground-value framework; under failure of RH, continuity produces a finite semidefinite terminal contact.
downstream_socket: Universal KNC plus compact-filtration localization implies global Weil positivity, hence RH through the accepted Weil criterion.
why_not_target_renamed: The audit explicitly tests whether universal KNC is strictly weaker than RH; the resulting theorem shows that, with the established propagation framework, it is RH-equivalent even though its contact operator has finite-dimensional domain.
abstract_convex_falsifier: A 2 by 2 charged-contact matrix has arbitrarily small nonzero charge but an immediate negative enlarged direction.
fejer_falsifier: Not applicable to this Weil-filtration theorem.
prime_density_pseudonode_falsifier: Not applicable to this Weil-filtration theorem.
finite_actual_prime_diagnostic: The prior p=5 contact-smear diagnostic is evidence only and does not certify KNC.
actual_prime_arithmetic_line: Any proof must establish exact cancellation of the exterior logarithmic flux by the combined pole, archimedean, and all active prime-shift traces.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: Global Weil positivity and RH; it is not merely a local lemma when universally quantified.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: An actual semidefinite zeta contact with nonzero charge would yield a larger-support negative direction and therefore refute RH.
stop_rule: Stop once the quantifiers and logical strength are exact and every proposed structure-only route is either connected by a proved adapter or killed by an exact countermodel.
